 Dinamo conceded four goals at Maksimir, Juve in crisis
 Europa League, third round
 714 views 0 comment(s) 
 Photo: Reuters 
 Disclaimer: The translations are mostly done through AI translator and might not be 100% accurate. 
 AH 
 Ah 
 22.10.2026. 20:53h 
 A cold shower for Dinamo and the first defeat in the Europa League this season.
 The Zagreb team conceded four goals to NEC Nijmegen at their Maksimir stadium - it was 4:2, although the "blues" easily turned the score around in the first half and took a 2:1 lead.
 Thus, after three rounds, the Croatian champion has four points...
 Bischof scored for the Dutchman in the 25th minute, but Beljo brought the first turning point in the match with goals in the 33rd and 37th minutes.
 It turned out that was all from the host.
 Linsen scored at the end of the first and the beginning of the second to give NEC a new lead, and the final score was set by Sherry with ten minutes left.
 And Juventus is in crisis, so the "old lady" fans booed their favorites for the second time in just a few days.
 Lazio outclassed the giants in Turin on Sunday (3:0), now Juve only managed a point in the duel with Rennes - 2:2.
 Dželik gave Juventus the lead in the 5th minute, Tamari and Dija scored for the guests before the break, and Voltemade scored from the penalty spot midway through the second half to tie the game.
 Bayer Leverkusen was better than OFI in the crisis (2:0, two goals from Hoffman), while Sunderland drew away to Polish Lech - 1:1.
 After an incomplete third round, the only ones with the maximum nine points are Bayer Leverkusen and Ferencvaros, who defeated Portuguese side Torense 4:1.
